title: Indexers
intro: Indexers are the sources nexcrate searches for downloads. Usenet indexers speak Newznab. Torrent trackers are connected through Prowlarr or Jackett, which speak Torznab. With a Prowlarr connection above, every indexer in Prowlarr comes by itself.
later: Here you check whether an indexer answers and what it returns. You search for a movie on its page in the library.

kind.label: Type
kind.torznabHint: For torrents through Prowlarr or Jackett.

state.noCaps: The indexer did not say how to search it. nexcrate uses the usual values instead.

lastError.label: Last error: {{text}}
lastError.keyRejected: The indexer rejected the API key.
lastError.notNewznab: Neither Newznab nor Torznab answers at this address.
lastError.wrongKind: The type does not match the indexer, Newznab and Torznab are mixed up.
lastError.unreachable: The indexer could not be reached.
lastError.timeout: The indexer did not answer in time.
lastError.httpError: The indexer answered with an HTTP error.
lastError.answerTooLarge: The indexer's answer was too large.
lastError.keyMissing: The stored API key could not be read.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: Anything you like, for example the indexer's name.
form.urlHint: The indexer's address, as in Radarr. Without a path, nexcrate adds /api. For Prowlarr the connection above is better; on its own, it is the address of the single indexer.
form.apiKeyHint: You find it in your account at the indexer. Some indexers do not need one.
form.keySaved: A key is saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.
form.keyNone: No key saved. If the indexer needs one, enter it here.
form.enabledHint: nexcrate does not ask an indexer that is turned off.
form.categoriesHint: nexcrate only searches in these categories. For movies usually everything from 2000 to 2999.
form.categoriesAfterTest: nexcrate shows the categories once the connection is tested.
form.categoriesDefault: The indexer names no categories. These are the usual ones for movies.
form.feedOk: Connection ok, the indexer returns results in the chosen categories.
form.feedEmpty: Connection ok, but nothing comes back in the chosen categories. Check the categories, maybe one is missing or none fits.
form.movieSearch: It can search for movies directly.
form.noMovieSearch: It can only do a general search, not search for movies directly.
form.testFirst: Test the connection first. Then you choose the categories.
form.priorityHint: When two releases are otherwise equally good, nexcrate takes the one from the indexer with the lower number. 1 is the highest priority, 50 the lowest, 25 is usual.
form.priorityInvalid: The priority is a whole number from 1 to 50.
form.dailyLimitHint: At most this many requests a day, from 1 to 100,000. When the indexer does not tell its limit itself, nexcrate plans the automatic searches within it. Empty means no limit.
form.dailyLimitInvalid: The daily limit is a whole number from 1 to 100,000. For no limit, leave the field empty.
form.minimumSeedersHint: nexcrate does not take torrents with fewer seeders. Without seeders a torrent never finishes. 1 is usual.
form.minimumSeedersInvalid: Enter a whole number from 0 for the seeders.
form.multiLanguagesHint: Some indexers put MULTi in the name when a release has several audio tracks, without naming the languages. Tick the languages MULTi means at this indexer. Without a tick, MULTi adds no language.
form.removeYear: Search by title without the year
form.removeYearHint: When nexcrate searches by title, it leaves out the year. Only switch this on if this indexer finds nothing with the year.
form.seriesCategoriesHint: nexcrate searches series only in these categories. Mostly everything from 5000 to 5999. Without any, nexcrate skips this indexer for series.
form.seriesCategoriesDefault: The indexer names no categories for series. These are the usual ones.
form.animeCategoriesAfterTest: After the test the indexer's anime categories are listed here.
form.animeCategoriesDefault: The default from the indexer's capabilities. An anime series asks these categories as well as those for series.
form.animeCategoriesNone: The indexer lists no anime category. An anime series asks only the categories for series here.
form.animeCategoriesChosen: Chosen by you. With an empty list an anime series asks only the categories for series here.
form.seriesFeedOk: The indexer delivers results in the series categories.
form.seriesFeedEmpty: Nothing comes back in the chosen series categories. Check the categories. You can still save.
form.seriesSearch: It can search for series directly.
form.noSeriesSearch: It can only search in general, not for series directly.
form.seriesCategoriesAfterTest: nexcrate shows the categories for series once the connection is checked.
form.musicCategoriesAfterTest: After the test the indexer's music categories are listed here.
form.musicCategoriesDefault: The default from the indexer's capabilities. It follows them until you choose yourself.
form.musicCategoriesChosen: Chosen by you. With an empty list nexcrate does not ask this indexer for albums.
form.musicLeftOut: An album search never asks it.
form.animeStandardFormatHint: An anime series is always searched for by the number it counts through (episode 148). With this ticked nexcrate also searches the usual form (S05E03). That finds more and costs requests at the indexer. Sonarr has this off from the start.
form.seedHint: Private trackers usually ask a torrent to keep seeding for a while, such as 72 hours or up to ratio 1. Stopping earlier risks a warning or a ban. nexcrate hands the goal to the download client with the torrent; empty keeps the client's own default.
form.packSeedTimeHint: For season packs and discographies. Empty: the normal seed time.
form.seedRatioInvalid: The ratio is a number from 0 to 1000, such as 1 or 1.5.
form.seedTimeInvalid: A seed time is a whole number of minutes, at most 525600 (a year).

remove.title: Remove indexer?
remove.text: The indexer {{name}} disappears from nexcrate. Nothing changes at the indexer itself.

search.title: Test search
search.intro: A single search to see what an indexer returns. nexcrate downloads nothing.
search.none: No results for this search term.
search.summaryLimited: The first {{shown}} of {{total}} results in {{ms}} ms

options.title: For every indexer
options.preferFlagsHint: As in Radarr, for movies only: when two releases tie on quality, score and indexer priority, the one with the better flags comes first (freeleech, double upload and internal count twice, halfleech once). Off by default. Sonarr has no such setting, so series are not concerned.

prowlarr.title: Prowlarr
prowlarr.intro: Enter Prowlarr once: nexcrate takes every indexer from it and keeps them up to date, when saving, at a click and every 15 minutes. New indexers in Prowlarr come by themselves, deleted ones go.
prowlarr.empty: No connection yet. Without Prowlarr you enter indexers one by one below.
prowlarr.dialogNote: This indexer comes from the Prowlarr connection "{{name}}".
prowlarr.dialogLocked: Name, address, key, on and off, priority, minimum seeders, categories and the seed goal are Prowlarr's; change them there, the next sync brings them here. Here you keep tags, MULTi languages, searching without the year, the anime standard format and the daily limit when Prowlarr sets none.
prowlarr.dialogAddRemove: Address and key follow the connection; you change everything else here.

counts.skippedCategories_one: {{count}} left out without a fitting category
counts.skippedCategories_other: {{count}} left out without a fitting category
counts.keptBlocked_one: {{count}} held back by Prowlarr right now, unchanged
counts.keptBlocked_other: {{count}} held back by Prowlarr right now, unchanged

errors.timeout: Prowlarr did not answer in time.
errors.keyRejected: Prowlarr did not accept the key. Made a new one? Then enter it here again.
errors.notProwlarr: It is not Prowlarr answering at this address. Is the URL base missing?
errors.tooOld: This Prowlarr version is too old; nexcrate needs 1.8.6 or newer.
errors.keyMissing: The stored key cannot be read. Enter it again.
errors.tagMissing: A chosen tag is gone from Prowlarr. Choose the tags again; until then everything stays as it is.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: As you open Prowlarr in the browser, with its URL base, such as http://prowlarr:9696. The indexers get this address with /1/api, /2/api and so on.
form.keySaved: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
form.levelFullHint: As Prowlarr's "Full Sync": what Prowlarr decides is written again at every sync, and you change it in Prowlarr. An indexer that no longer fits goes.
form.levelAddRemoveHint: As Prowlarr's "Add and Remove Only": new indexers come, deleted ones go; nexcrate takes everything else only when adding.
form.tagsHint: As Prowlarr's tags on an app. Without a tick every indexer comes. Prowlarr's tags do not become tags in nexcrate.
form.tagsAfterTest: After the test, Prowlarr's tags stand here.
form.enabledHint: Off: no sync, the indexers stay as they are.

remove.title: Remove the Prowlarr connection
remove.text_one: {{name}} is removed, with {{count}} indexer from it. Waiting releases of this indexer go too; downloads keep its name.
remove.text_other: {{name}} is removed, with {{count}} indexers from it. Waiting releases of these indexers go too; downloads keep their names.
remove.textKeep_one: {{name}} is removed. The indexer stays as an indexer of its own, without a sync.
remove.textKeep_other: {{name}} is removed. The {{count}} indexers stay as indexers of their own, without a sync.
remove.keepHint: They stay with address and key and can be changed and removed afterwards like any indexer.
